inputs.state_model: frozen eight-state causal forward semi-Markov detector

joint_kernel.formula: P_history(next_state | previous_state_2, previous_state_1, current_state) * P_backoff(dwell_bucket | previous_state_2, previous_state_1, current_state, next_state)
joint_kernel.interpretation: A normalized joint next-state/dwell kernel by the probability chain rule; destination marginals remain the retained history model.
joint_kernel.session_end_reason: The terminal run duration is truncated by the session boundary rather than an observed natural state departure.

selection.schedule: expanding monthly histories scored July through December 2024
selection.criterion: lowest pooled held-forward dwell log loss for the full order-3 conditional PMF

rollout.anchors: every causal state-run entry with zero-based New York clock bar ordinal <= 53
rollout.route_context_update: previous_state_2 <- previous_state_1; previous_state_1 <- current_state; current_state <- hypothesised next_state
rollout.completion_probability: sum of the dynamically convolved joint transition/dwell mass with total dwell <= horizon over deduplicated compatible cycle rotations
rollout.completion_target: one when a compatible exact future state route closes within-session and the sum of constituent observed run durations is <= horizon

models.history_path_only: retained destination-path probability with no completion-time adjustment
models.history_frozen_state_timed: retained destination probabilities multiplied dynamically by frozen semi-Markov current-state duration PMFs
models.history_destination_timed: retained destination probabilities multiplied dynamically by q1(dwell | current_state, next_state)
models.history_order2_timed: diagnostic retained destination probabilities multiplied dynamically by q2(dwell | previous_state_1, current_state, next_state)
models.history_joint_timed: candidate retained destination probabilities multiplied dynamically by q3(dwell | previous_state_2, previous_state_1, current_state, next_state)

decision.retain_only_if: support, both primary comparisons, path-only sanity, and integrity gates pass in both 2025 and backward-2023
decision.simpler_partial_decision: If destination-conditioned timing passes versus frozen state-only timing in both periods but full-history timing fails versus destination-conditioned timing, retain only the simpler destination-conditioned dwell hypothesis and keep the full-history kernel rejected.
decision.failed_experiment_action: retain the history-only loop identity forecaster and keep joint completion timing rejected
decision.successful_experiment_interpretation: research evidence for which compatible loop completes within 6/12/24 bars; not price direction, economic edge, or tradability
